title: Putnami Output Contract
description: Defines the observable outputs a Putnami workload produces. All workloads communicate through structured JSONL on stdout. This schema describes the categories of output and their expected formats.

OutputChannel.description: Output stream. Structured JSONL goes to stdout. Unstructured human-readable output goes to stderr.

OutputFormat.description: Output format mode. 'jsonl' streams structured events. 'text' renders human-readable output. 'cloud-logging' emits Google Cloud structured JSON.

OutputContract.description: The complete output contract for a job execution.

LogOutput.description: Structured log output via JSONL 'log' events.

levels.description: Supported log levels. All levels should be supported; filtering is done by the consumer.

MetricOutput.description: Named measurements emitted via JSONL 'metric' events.

wellKnown.description: Well-known metric names that tools can aggregate and display.

DiagnosticOutput.description: Structured warnings and errors emitted via JSONL 'diagnostic' events. Diagnostics include optional source location for IDE integration.

ArtifactOutput.description: Named output files or directories emitted via JSONL 'artifact' events.

TraceOutput.description: OpenTelemetry trace integration. Reserved for future use.

enabled.description: Whether OpenTelemetry trace export is supported.
